subject: M-RL kickoff: making Munchausen agents our value-based baseline suite
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kickoff for the Munchausen RL effort. Context: our open-source M-RL release ships two agents on top of Dopamine — M-DQN and M-IQN — plus an Advantage Learning implementation used for ablations. Teams keep re-running these ad hoc; the product here is a maintained, reproducible value-based baseline suite for the whole agents-rl portfolio, with pinned configs (the atari.gin path) and published reference curves.

Milestones inside the window (02-16 to 05-25): repo hygiene and the train.py entry point wrapped for our infra by mid-March, full Atari sweep for M-DQN by end of April, M-IQN plus the AL ablation by mid-May, reference curves on Evalline before close.

Biggest known wart: the release is TensorFlow v1, no eager mode. Want your read on whether we port or contain.

Ulla
